Its docs also reference client-side and server-side SDKs, Edge Proxy connectivity from server-side SDKs, OpenFeature compatibility, and show a `flagsmith.hasFeature` code sample. missing for 10: per-language SDK reference docs in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
